section.t: The sender SHALL NOT wait. Clients and servers SHOULD NOT retry. Echoing is NOT RECOMMENDED for caches. Caching is RECOMMENDED. A user agent is REQUIRED to stop. A reply is OPTIONAL. It MAY be sent by a server. A gateway SHOULD log it and MUST drop it. An implementation must not, shall not and should not count lowercase words, which are not required.

tr.th: A recipient MUST read the head.

dl.dt: A client MUST never see this term.
